title: sufr declares chrono and home but never uses them, and lists pretty_assertions twice
body:
`sufr/Cargo.toml` lists `chrono` (line 17) and `home` (21). Grepping `sufr/src` finds no use of either. `meta.modified.format(..)` (`sufr/src/lib.rs:576`) calls a method on a value whose type comes from libsufr, which declares its own `chrono` (`libsufr/Cargo.toml:18`). `pretty_assertions` appears at lines 25 and 33, as a regular dependency and again as a dev-dependency. The two `chrono` pins also differ, 0.4.38 in `sufr` and 0.4.39 in `libsufr`.

Seen by grep and reading in the survey. The build was not run without them.
